configurePresets.description: Local development. The generator is pinned to VS 2022 instead of upstream's 'Visual Studio 18 2026' + v145 for two reasons: VS 2026 supports Windows 11 only (see Microsoft's system requirements), while VS 2022 Build Tools install on Windows 10 22H2; and this way a local build and a CI build compile with the same compiler. Change it back if you are on Windows 11 with VS 2026.
configurePresets.name: default

configurePresets.description: GitHub Actions preset. 'Visual Studio 17 2022' on purpose: windows-latest ships VS 2022 17.14, and neither the 'Visual Studio 18 2026' generator nor toolset v145 exists there. A generator is mandatory in a configure preset -- CMake refuses to fall back to its own detection ('Preset "ci" missing field "generator"'). COPY_BUILD is off because MMOHOTBAR_DEPLOY_DIR is a local path that does not exist on a runner.
configurePresets.name: ci
